title: Evaluate Division
statement_short: Given equations of variable divisions and an array of values, answer query divisions between variables. Return -1.0 if a division query cannot be determined.
hint: Small query limits allow constructing a weighted directed graph and evaluating path products per query.
why_not: Right: Graph DFS traverses variable edge paths to accumulate multiplicative weight ratios in O(Q \* (V + E)) time. Not Union-Find: Disjoint sets with weight tracking also solve query ratios in O((V + E) + Q \* alpha(V)) time, but graph traversal directly models path multiplication. Not 1D DP: Dynamic programming state caching does not handle arbitrary graph query paths without precomputing Floyd-Warshall all-pairs matrices. Not Two Pointers: Scanning pointer pairs cannot navigate non-linear weighted ratio edges.
complexity: O(Q \* (V + E)) time, O(V + E) space
